title: God Makes A Way For Worship

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: But if that place is too distant and you have been blessed by the Lord your God and cannot carry your tithe (because the place where the Lord will choose to put his Name is so far away), then exchange your tithe for silver, and take the silver with you and go to the place the Lord your God will choose. Use the silver to buy whatever you like: cattle, sheep, wine or other fermented drink, or anything you wish. Then you and your household shall eat there in the presence of the Lord your God and rejoice. - Deut 14:24-26 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God shows remarkable practical care in these verses. What if someone lived too far from the place of worship to carry all their tithe there? God provided a gracious solution: exchange it for silver, carry the silver, and buy what was needed upon arrival. God did not make worship burdensome or impossible; He made a way for His people to come and rejoice in His presence. And once again, the goal was joy — "you and your household shall eat there... and rejoice."

This reveals the heart of God toward His worshippers. He is not a harsh taskmaster who piles impossible demands on His people. He removes obstacles and makes a way for them to draw near. The distant worshipper was not excluded or shamed; God provided a practical path so they too could come and celebrate. God's instructions are shaped by care for real people in real situations.

How much more has God made a way for us to draw near through Christ! The greatest obstacle to worship was never distance but our sin, and God removed it Himself. Through Jesus, "we have confidence to enter the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus" (Heb 10:19). No one is too far, too unworthy, or too burdened to come. God has made the way, at infinite cost to Himself, and He invites us to draw near with joy. And notice the intended atmosphere: rejoicing. Worship is meant to be a celebration in God's presence. Come to God today through the way He has opened, and rejoice — He has removed every obstacle so that you can draw near.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do I see God as one who makes a way for me, or as a harsh taskmaster?
- How has God removed the obstacles between me and Himself through Christ?
- Is my worship marked by joyful rejoicing in God's presence?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that You make a way for me to draw near, removing every obstacle through the blood of Jesus. No one is too far or unworthy to come. Help me approach You with confidence and joy, rejoicing in Your presence. Amen.
